uncertain: LEFT and RIGHT sideLengthM 9.84 is NOT printed and not a sum of printed parts: it is the walled depth scaled from the dashed wall outline on the dimensioned site plan (and the same on the floor plan, both against the printed 1552); about +-0.1 m. It is filed as DERIVED_FROM_PLAN for want of a better label.
The elevations are only 709 px wide (about 33 px per metre); box edges are good to about 3 px (0.1 m).
Zero row: the plinth top is at row 285, the entrance threshold at 291, the ground at about 305; 291 is used on all four sides. With it the ridge computes to 7.9 m against the printed +7,97.

Side elevations are captioned only 'elewacja boczna'; assigned from the plan: the gable with one window below and two balcony doors with a curved balcony above is LEFT, the blank garage gable is RIGHT. Neither is mirrored.

On LEFT the wall is solid for about 8.0 m from the rear (x 144-411); the front 1.8 m is the open side arch of the covered terrace with the gable wall continuing above it and a brick corner column (x 453-474).
B3 and B4 stand side by side with a pier of about 0.14 m between the frames; they could be read as one paired opening.
Left front dormer read as ROOF_GABLE (roof tiles run below it, the covered terrace is under it), right front dormer as WALL_GABLE (its wall continues down into the bedroom facade).
The railing in front of F6 stands on a thin ledge; it may be only a French balcony.
Garage roof windows F8 and B7 light a storage attic (strych) over the garage; level 1 is used.
The section prints 842 from terrain to ridge; the page text gives a building height of 8.5 m.
